effects: Takes `amount` of the vault's collateral (wstETH) from the signer via transferFrom, which spends the signer's prior approval to the vault.
Mints active vault shares (the vault ERC-20) to `onBehalfOf`. The share count comes from the current stake/share ratio. When onBehalfOf is not the signer, the position belongs to someone else.
Reverts if the deposit whitelist or the deposit limit blocks it. No native value: the function is not payable.
formats.shown: Deposit <amount> wstETH for <beneficiary> into the named vault. The amount, the beneficiary and the vault are all shown as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of vault shares minted to onBehalfOf is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_)` uses the stake/share ratio in storage. The descriptor has no shares field.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. Optionally say in the intent that the deposit mints vault shares to the beneficiary.

findings.title: deposit: the token is a hardcoded wstETH constant, not read from each vault's collateral.
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.underlyingToken = 0x7f39C581...; `#.amount` uses params.token = $.metadata.constants.underlyingToken. Vault.sol reads `collateral` from storage. Only 0x8327...'s init data confirms collateral 0x7f39c581... (meta.json constructorArguments). For the other three deployments, the case descriptions say wstETH and case 4's share symbol is gtrwstETH, but I could not read their storage.
findings.fix: Keep this file to wstETH-collateral vaults only. Confirm each deployment's collateral() equals wstETH.

effects: Burns enough of the signer's active vault shares to cover `amount` of collateral. The share count comes from the current ratio.
Moves `amount` wstETH of stake into the next epoch's withdrawal queue. The withdrawal shares are credited to `claimer`, so only claimer can claim it after the next epoch ends.
The queued amount stays slashable until it is claimed. No tokens move now. Not payable.
formats.shown: Request <amount> wstETH withdrawal for <claimer> from the vault. The fields are the requested assets and the claim owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the vault shares burned from the signer are not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake())`; _withdraw pushes `activeSharesOf(msg.sender) - burnedShares`. The share count is computed from storage.
findings.fix: None from calldata. The intent could say the request burns vault shares.

findings.title: withdraw: 'for {claimer}' does not say that claimer alone can collect the funds.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: `withdrawalSharesOf[epoch][claimer] += mintedShares`; _claim pays only `withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)`. Descriptor interpolatedIntent: 'Request {amount} withdrawal for {claimer}'. The claimer is shown in the field 'Claim owner'.
findings.fix: Use wording like 'Request {amount} withdrawal, claimable by {claimer} after the next epoch'.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's vault tokens.

Queues the matching collateral (wstETH) amount, computed from the current ratio, for the next epoch. The withdrawal shares are credited to `claimer`, so only claimer can claim after the next epoch ends.
No tokens move now. Not payable.
formats.shown: Queue <shares> <vault share symbol> for <claimer>. The fields are the vault shares (token from @.to) and the claim owner.

findings.title: redeem: the 'Queue {shares} for {claimer}' sentence does not say the shares are burned for a withdrawal.
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent 'Queue {shares} for {claimer}'. Case 4 renders 'Queue 2.25 gtrwstETH for 0x2ED2…'. Vault.sol _withdraw burns the shares and credits withdrawal shares to claimer.
findings.fix: Use 'Redeem {shares} for a withdrawal claimable by {claimer}'.

findings.title: redeem: the wstETH amount that will be queued is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares())` is computed from storage.

effects: Sends the signer's whole matured withdrawal for `epoch` (withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)) in wstETH from the vault to `recipient`.
Marks that epoch as claimed for the signer, which consumes the claim right. Not payable.
formats.shown: Claim epoch <epoch> to <recipient> from the vault. The epoch is shown as a raw number. Neither the asset nor the amount is named.

findings.title: claim: the wstETH amount sent to recipient is not shown, because it is stored per epoch.
findings.fix: None from calldata. Naming the asset in the intent helps: 'Claim wstETH withdrawal for epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

effects: Sends the sum of the signer's matured withdrawals for every listed epoch, in wstETH, from the vault to `recipient`.
Marks each listed epoch as claimed for the signer. Not payable.
formats.shown: Claim epochs <list> to <recipient> from the vault. Each epoch is shown as a raw number. Neither the asset nor the total amount is named.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total wstETH sent to recipient is not shown, because it is stored per epoch.
findings.fix: None from calldata. Name the asset in the intent: 'Claim wstETH withdrawals for epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

redeem(address claimer,uint256 shares).worst: redeem: the 'Queue {shares} for {claimer}' sentence does not say the shares are burned for a withdrawal.
